title: Butterflies – Callicore hesperis, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description With its bold contrasts and graphic symmetry, the Callicore hesperis butterfly looks like a natural design experiment. This silver coin by Mennica Polska reveals its intricate wing structure with a magnifying lens and digital printing. Another chapter in the “Butterflies” series – created for those who see art in every living form.
